title: zenclaw: a write, three tiers, and the snapshot timer
subtitle: PSRAM cache -> coalesced replication -> flash snapshot every 900 s

messages.label: append: extend active log-NN in cache
coalesce: same key already queued -> replace bytes
error: backoff 2^(n-1) s, retry to retry_max
still failing: demote to dead-letter list
log reaches 16,384 B: fold into base.jsonl
every 900 s: snapshot() the whole cache

messages.note: Flash sees one atomic whole-state write per interval - not one write per turn
